Mary Roberts Rinehart, The Circular Staircase.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/mary-roberts-rinehart/the-circular-staircase

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Mary Roberts Rinehart, the author, died 1958.

First publication of the text used: 1907, serialized in the United States magazine All-Story from its November 1907 issue, then published as a book by Bobbs-Merrill in 1908 (SE colophon: 'The Circular Staircase was published in 1908 by Mary Roberts Rinehart.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in the United States in 1907 (serialized in All-Story) and in 1908 (book, Bobbs-Merrill), before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so it entered by 2003.
- Country of origin (United States): the first publication was in the United States, so the United States rule settles the origin too, whatever the death year. The last to die did so in 1958.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
